{!Contact.FirstName},
Thanks for your job inquiry, but at this time it appears that you need more experience in your specialty.
All of our positions require a minimum of 2 years of experience. They also require that you have been working within that specialty within the last 6 months.
I will check back in with you in the future as you gain necessary experience. Again, thank for inquiring and best of luck!
{!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName} {!User.Email}
